Description fixes
Perk Fixes and Rebalance
Naval battles only
The melee (Blow) and ranged (Volley) armor penetration, personal and captain, only applies in naval battles. Vanilla applies it in every battle. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Armor penetration %
Armor penetration from each perk, personal and captain. Vanilla is 50. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Two-handed weapons only

The armor penetration only applies to two-handed weapon attacks. Vanilla applies it to every attack, like a general bonus rather than a Two Handed one. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Armor penetration %
Armor penetration from Vandal. Vanilla is 25. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Movement speed perks work while holding a shield

Vanilla skips these while a troop has a shield in its off hand: captain Morning Exercise, Shield Bearer, Fleet of Foot, Reckless Charge, Footwork, Form Fitting Armor and Sprint, and personal Morning Exercise and Self Medication. This applies them with a shield too. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Form Fitting Armor (Athletics, 50): applies once

Vanilla adds the captain bonus twice to tier 3+ infantry without a shield (+8%), once to others without a shield, and not at all to non-infantry with a shield. This gives every tier 3+ unmounted troop +4%, as described. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Wrapped Handles (One-Handed, 25)

The captain +One Handed skill goes to every troop in the formation, mounted or on foot. Vanilla skips any troop with a horse in its equipment, so cavalry and horse archers never get it, even on foot. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Strong Grip (Two-Handed, 25)

The captain +Two Handed skill goes to every troop in the formation, mounted or on foot. Vanilla skips any troop with a horse in its equipment, so cavalry and horse archers never get it, even on foot. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Clean Thrust (Polearm, 75)

The captain +Polearm skill goes to every troop in the formation, mounted or on foot. Vanilla skips any troop with a horse in its equipment, so cavalry and horse archers never get it, even on foot. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Counterweight (Polearm, 250)

The captain +Polearm skill goes to every troop in the formation, mounted or on foot. Vanilla skips any troop with a horse in its equipment, so cavalry and horse archers never get it, even on foot. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Flexible Fighter (Throwing, 50): also score for horse archers

Order-of-battle only. Vanilla tags Foot (infantry and archers). Horse archers get the melee-skill half of the captain bonus but do not score. When on, the tag is Any so horse-archer formations score it too. Does not change who receives the bonus in battle. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Flexible Fighter (Throwing, 50): cavalry get Bow, Crossbow and Throwing

Cavalry get the same captain skill bonus as infantry. Archers and horse archers still get One Handed, Two Handed and Polearm only. Turn off for vanilla, where cavalry get nothing from this perk. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Picked Shots (250): crossbow troops only
The -50% wage for tier 4+ ranged troops and the +5 HP for ranged troops only apply to troops that carry a crossbow. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Artisan Community (125): recruit slot from quartermaster

The +1 recruitment slot with merchant notables comes from the quartermaster of the recruiting hero's party, as described. Vanilla reads the recruiting hero (usually the party leader). Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Rapid Development (175): price discount from quartermaster

The -25% price when buying clay, iron, raw silk and silver only needs the quartermaster to have the perk, as described. Vanilla also needs the clan leader to have it. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Sledges (75): mount HP from surgeon
The +15 mount HP comes from the party surgeon instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Fortitude Tonic (225): hero HP from surgeon
The party-wide +HP goes to every hero except the surgeon, instead of every hero except the leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Minister of Health (275): troop HP from surgeon
Troop HP bonus reads the surgeon's perk and Medicine instead of the leader's, in battles and in RBM's auto-resolve. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Minister of Health (275): HP per Medicine point above 250
Troop HP per Medicine point above 250, from whoever holds the perk. Vanilla is 1. The default 0.675 gives +50 HP at 330 Medicine. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Masterwork (275): skill from engineer

The siege engine damage scales with the Engineering of the engineer, who is the one that needs the perk. Vanilla uses the party leader's Engineering. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Tactical Mastery (275): party leader

Vanilla labels Mastery as army commander but only ever buffs the army leader's own party, and only while an army exists. This makes it a party leader perk so any party (including a lone one) gets it from its leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Army commander perks apply without an army

On The March, Great Leader (battle-start morale), Enemy of the Wood, and Commodore also work for a party that is not in an army, using that party's leader. Does not invent a commander for ad-hoc multi-party battles. Encirclement combat is already party leader; its cohesion discount still needs a real army. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Streamlined Operations (50): ballista reload from first mate

The +10% ballista reload speed in naval battles comes from the first mate, as described. Vanilla reads it from the formation captain, where it never applies. Also says reload speed instead of reload time. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Gilded Purse (100): ship capture from first mate
The ship capture chance comes from the first mate instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Arr! / Pirate Hunter (175): captain battle XP

Captain XP after naval battles works from the formation captain (like Inspiring Leader). Vanilla never applies it: it uses party HasPerk for the Captain role, which always fails. Naval battles only; descriptions and captain scoring match. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Special Arrows (125): sail damage from first mate

The +40% damage to enemy sails from troops' fire arrows comes from the first mate, as described. Vanilla reads it from the formation captain and adds the captain value instead (+5 flat damage). Captain +5 armor for tier 1-3 troops stays with the captain and only applies in naval battles. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Smooth Operator (150): ballista ammo from first mate
The +5 ballista ammo comes from the ship owner's first mate, as described. Vanilla reads it from the ship's captain, where it never applies. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Accuracy Training (150): ranged shield damage from first mate

The +30% ranged damage to shields in naval battles comes from the first mate, as described. Vanilla reads it from the formation captain, where it never applies. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Popular Captain (175): deck size from first mate
The deck size bonus comes from the first mate instead of the party leader. The mariner recruitment discount stays with the leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Port Authority (200): ship limit from first mate
The +1 ship to the command limit comes from the first mate instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Blessings of the Sea (200): ship limit from first mate
The +1 ship to the command limit comes from the first mate instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Shipwright's Hand (225): ship repair from first mate
Repairing your ships from discarded ones comes from the first mate instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Merchant Fleet (250): battle ship limit from first mate
The +1 ship to the battle limit comes from the first mate instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Unflinching (175): disembark speed from navigator
The faster disembarking comes from the navigator instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Shore Master (175): recall time from navigator
The halved ship recall time comes from the navigator instead of the party leader, so both effects are the navigator's. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Fleet Commander (200): both effects from navigator
Both effects (fleet-size speed penalty and skeleton crew) come from the navigator instead of the party leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Stormrider (225): ship limit from navigator
The +1 ship limit comes from the navigator instead of the party leader. The troop XP stays with the leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Master and Commander (225): ship limit from navigator
The +1 ship limit comes from the navigator instead of the party leader. The troop XP stays with the leader. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Clarify perk descriptions

Clearer perk tooltips only: captain conditions, quiver types, auto-resolve wording, and similar. No gameplay change. Turn off if another mod edits those texts. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Role perks from party leader or role hero

A scout, quartermaster, surgeon, engineer, first mate or navigator effect applies if either that role's hero or the party leader has the perk (once). Skill-scaling uses the higher skill. Ship-limit pairs still give +1. Also applies to AI. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
Tactics auto-resolve effects in battles

Auto-resolve Tactics bonuses also apply in battles you fight, at about 20%–50% strength. Land battles for most effects; Tactical Mastery also at sea at half rate. Captain bonuses are unchanged. Applies when you click Done, or when a game is loaded.
